title: Ingestion queue full: 235/239 success already sent before queue check
description: transit/peering/session.rs:269: enqueue_article() calls try_enqueue() after the success response (235 or 239) is already written. If the queue is full, the peer believes the article was accepted and will not retry, but the article is silently dropped. The rate limiter does not check queue depth. Fix: check queue depth before sending the success response, or send 431 (Transfer failed — try again) instead.
